desc: Analyze the problem constraints and movement rules.
Determine the necessary condition: R must be even.
Design the construction for B=0 (Rectangle perimeter).
Design the construction for B>0 (Alternating pattern with a specific closing mechanism).

Implement the solution logic: Check if R is even. If not, output "No". If yes, construct the coordinates. For B=0, use a rectangle perimeter. For B>0, use the alternating pattern $R, B, R, B \dots$ adjusted to close the cycle, or a specific construction that works for all even R and B>0.
For each test case, read R and B.
Else, generate the sequence of pieces and their coordinates.
